q: A ____ body is a body that does not deform or change shape. (2024)
e: A rigid body is an ideal physical body that does not undergo deformation or change in shape when external forces are applied.

q: ____ acceleration is present in both uniform and non-uniform circular motion. (2025)
e: Centripetal acceleration is always required in any circular motion to continuously change the direction of velocity toward the center.

q: In nonuniform circular motion, an object is moving in a circular path with a varying ____. (2026)
e: In non-uniform circular motion, the speed of the moving object changes along the circular path, producing tangential acceleration.

q: The direction of the angular velocity vector is ____ to the plane of rotation, and along the axis of rotation. (2025)
e: By the right-hand rule, the angular velocity vector lies along the axis of rotation, perpendicular to the plane of motion.

q: The average angular acceleration of a rotor which is accelerated from rest to 900 rpm in 10 s is ____ rad s^-2. (2025)
e: Converting 900 rpm gives 30π rad/s. Dividing the change in angular velocity (30π rad/s) by time (10 s) yields an angular acceleration of 3π rad s^-2.

q: The direction of tangential acceleration is always ____ to the circular path. (2025)
e: Tangential acceleration acts parallel to the velocity vector along the tangent line of the circular path.

q: The motion of a fan's blades is ____ motion. (2025)
e: The fan blades rotate around a fixed central axis, which defines rotational motion.

q: ____ acceleration is present in both uniform and non-uniform circular motion. (2021)
e: Centripetal acceleration is essential for maintaining circular motion in both uniform and non-uniform cases.

q: The relation between linear velocity and angular velocity is ____. (2021)
e: Linear velocity (v) is directly proportional to angular velocity (ω) multiplied by the radius (r).

q: One revolution per second (1 rps) is equal to ____ radian per second. (2021)
e: One complete revolution corresponds to an angle of 2π radians, so 1 rps equals 2π rad/s.

q: Angular velocity is the rate of change of angular displacement with respect to ____. (2021)
e: Angular velocity is defined mathematically as the rate at which angular displacement changes over time.

q: The direction of tangential acceleration is always ____ to the circular path. (2026)
e: Tangential acceleration acts along the tangent to the circular path at any given point.

q: The angular speed is the ____ for all points on a rotating circular plate. (2026)
e: All points on a rigid rotating body sweep through the same angular displacement in a given time, so they share the same angular speed.

q: The equation ω² = ω₀² + 2 α θ is analogous to ____ in linear motion. (2026)
e: The rotational kinematic formula corresponds directly to the third linear kinematic equation where angular variables replace linear variables.
